scope: Make the shared listing map picker noticeable for both roles, soften orange field focus, and start new seeker request budgets at zero.
environment: Real LocationField and LocationEditor components in a temporary local preview. The preview route was removed before the production build; no listing or account data was submitted.
browserChecks: Both roles and both themes inspected, with empty and selected locations.
Desktop map controls are 504px wide and at least 88px high, with no horizontal overflow.
390px browser-frame controls are 314px wide, with wrapped copy and the action below it; no horizontal overflow.
Keyboard Tab and Enter open and close the native summary; the existing lazy map editor appears.
Provider phone map opens with pin, zoom and fullscreen controls visible.
Orange field focus uses a muted 55% accent border and 10% ring; provider focus retains its existing green tone.
The original browser theme was restored and temporary preview tabs were closed.

validation.eslint: Passed for LocationField, PostRequest, PostRequest tests and ProposalModal.
validation.tests: 52 unique tests passed across six files: PostRequest, LocationEditor, OfferServices, ProposalModal, RequestServiceModal and MarketplaceLocationControl.
validation.productionBuild: Passed; TypeScript succeeded and 109 pages generated. Temporary preview route is absent.

limitations: Responsive checks use a browser frame, not a physical phone. Saved areas in the preview are sample data; publishing and backend behavior were not changed.
